title: Flight dynamics, turbulence and take-off
description: Verification of the flight-dynamics library: turbulence spectra and variances against MIL-F-8785C, trim of the four aircraft held for 10 s stick fixed, energy / angular-momentum conservation of the integrator, the lattice-in-the-loop lift against the steady vortex lattice. Writes results/verification.json and the PSD figure.
